description: Count earthquakes matching a filter without returning the events — fast for questions like "how many M5+ quakes in the last month near X". Same filters as search_earthquakes (time, magnitude, circular area). Keyless.

end_time.description: ISO date/time upper bound. Defaults to now.

latitude.description: Center latitude for a circular search.

longitude.description: Center longitude for a circular search.

max_radius_km.description: Search radius in km around latitude/longitude.

start_time.description: ISO date/time lower bound. Defaults to 30 days ago.

name: count_earthquakes
title: Count Earthquakes
